cases.scope: Synthetic core contract cases; Review output/schema APIs for ordered bounded normalized stage observations without raw traffic or local censorship classifications.

Synthetic core contract cases; Test common field presence/types/status-dependent failure, unknown fields and allowed test-specific observation types. Preserve order and omit never-attempted operations.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test each normalized DNS failure and observable response-code pairing; a system resolver with no code must not invent one.
Synthetic core contract cases; Exercise engine/family/query-type/response-count fields and canary prohibited resolver/raw-message fields.
Synthetic core contract cases; Exercise sequential arrival indexes, quantized timing, closed normalized rcode values and bounded answer/CNAME counts.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test canonical A/AAAA/CNAME values, first-occurrence deduplication, TTL omission, reviewed-query limits and no on-device enrichment.
Synthetic core contract cases; Map each TCP failure conservatively and keep outer cancellation/network/proxy/deadline conditions exclusively in execution.reason.
Synthetic core contract cases; Validate address family and exclude target address/port canaries.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test all registered TLS failures, preceding TCP failure and no TLS observation before TLS activity.
Synthetic core contract cases; Exercise conditional negotiated fields with closed version/ALPN/alert vocabularies and bounded ALPN; exclude every prohibited certificate/handshake/key/session field.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test registered HTTP failures and preceding DNS/TCP/TLS observations; emit HTTP only once HTTP activity starts.
Synthetic core contract cases; Validate conditional status/redirect/body/checks/content-encoding fields and count limits.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test redirect counts/classes including uncontacted rejected redirects; exclude full destination data.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test processed-byte/truncation boundaries and omit raw body/digests.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test kind/index/matched associations without retaining expected or actual header/body/digest values.

Synthetic core contract cases; Test that vocabularies are closed with no runtime registry lookup; decoders reject aliases, wrong case, numeric strings and raw library messages without repairing them into coarse markers; keep missing evidence, malformed data and out-of-subset values distinct.

Synthetic core contract cases; Map each effective code 0-5 and an out-of-subset code including extended bits; omit responses without a reliable code; exclude raw codes/diagnostics; keep OTHER distinct from success/no-data and map unregistered nonzero codes conservatively to inconclusive.

Synthetic core contract cases; Map negotiated 0x0303/0x0304/other versions and http/1.1, h2, dot and other negotiated ALPN; absent fields when nothing reliable was negotiated; ignore record-layer/offered versions; never copy unregistered identifiers or let coarse markers override failures.
Synthetic core contract cases; Accept only offered http/1.1, h2 and dot; reject unknown, h2c, case variants and other registry entries alongside existing count, length and duplicate bounds.

Synthetic core contract cases; Map every listed received peer description code and an unlisted code; omit alert when the description is unavailable; exclude local cancellation, deadline, validation failures, sent alerts and post-handshake closure; serialize no raw alert data.
Synthetic core contract cases; For each observation type, omit failure on incomplete status and reject null, empty or registered failure values; keep termination in execution.reason.

Synthetic core contract cases; Parameterize each invariant, including one terminal failed/incomplete primitive observation, allowed types, bounds, status/detail consistency and inconclusive for unmapped raw errors.
Synthetic core contract cases; Review downstream examples for source-layer interpretation without attributing intent or definitive interference.
Synthetic core contract cases; Feed negative DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP terminal observations; produce completed measurements without automatic retries.
Synthetic core contract cases; Exercise required/conditional fields, encoded bytes/observation counts and task_id association. Exclude automatic task-field copies and reversible input digests.

Synthetic core contract cases; Inject a controlled random source; new runs get independent IDs, retries preserve ID/increment attempt, retransmission creates no attempt, and IDs never escape to measurement/context/log sinks.
Synthetic core contract cases; Select exact registered test/result-version tuples independently; reject unknown fields and unsupported combinations.
Synthetic core contract cases; Validate bounded released version and platform enum; exclude host/device/build/locale metadata and arbitrary annotations.
Synthetic core contract cases; Use a monotonic fake clock plus wall-clock jumps; test minute floor, 250ms ceiling including zero, stage rounding and duration_capped conditional behavior.
Synthetic core contract cases; Exercise all states/reasons, first termination precedence, measurement presence/absence/partial rules and separation of malformed task errors from results.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test completed/incomplete remote tests with unavailable egress, pre-snapshot not_run and NET-01 exceptions; reject prohibited context data.
Synthetic core contract cases; Select the registered Output schema, ordered observation list and terminal outcome; reject unregistered extensions/verdicts.
Synthetic core contract cases; Interrupt each stage of NET-05 and primitive tests; retain only schema-permitted partial data and distinguish skipped from failed operations.

Synthetic core contract cases; Reject unknown known-version fields and unsupported exact versions; quarantine, if provided, cannot analyze a silently reduced object. Reject host/task injected extensions.

Synthetic core contract cases; Parameterize all common validity rules, including all-zero/incorrect run IDs, retry bound, timestamps, duration cap, terminal outcomes and prohibited data before bundling.
Synthetic core contract cases; Canary every prohibited identifier/raw-data sink; review aggregate retention and separate versioned derived analysis from source observations.
Synthetic core contract cases; Keep one access generation and selected path; reject raw IP/persistent context identity.
Synthetic core contract cases; Require access/egress objects and reject unknown top-level fields.
Synthetic core contract cases; Exercise exact coarse enums/types and reject every prohibited platform identifier.
Synthetic core contract cases; Test all status/source/path/connection-code/classification combinations, missing optional classification, and no guessed values.
Synthetic core contract cases; Reject free-form provider/operator data; review analysis labels and any proposed operator extension for required specialist review.
